item.description: ### Added - **Jump-to-terminal lands on the right Zellij pane.** Clicking a session that runs inside Zellij now switches Zellij to the exact tab and pane hosting the agent — verified against the live process, so a finished session can never focus someone else's pane — and then raises the terminal as before. Perch also stops asking Terminal.app or Ghostty for Automation access it cannot use while a session is inside Zellij.
